children.text: Trigger Finger (trigger thumb when involving the thumb) is the inhibition of smooth tendon gliding due to mechanical impingement at the level of the A1 pulley that causes progressive pain, clicking, catching, and locking of the digit.
Diagnosis is made by physical examination with presence of active triggering and tenderness at the A1 pulley.
Treatment consists of splinting, anti-inflammatory medications, steroid injections, and surgical release.
